title: relay_queue DKIM failure moves env before msg: partial-move leaves orphan .msg
description: In try_deliver_one, DKIM failure iterates [env_path, msg_path] in that order (line 366). If the env rename succeeds but the msg rename fails (e.g. cross-device rename, filesystem error), the live queue has a .msg with no .env — the next drain skips it (no .env), and it is only retired on the next restart via cleanup_orphan_msg_files. The dead/ directory has an .env with no .msg, which inflates the dead-letter count metric. The operator sees a dead-letter without a payload, which is confusing and misleading. Should move msg first, then env — consistent with the enqueue write order (msg first).
